page.overview:
Who is Rislyn?

Rislyn was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah in a Mirror World.

Rislyn is given charge of the defenses of the White Tower in the absence of the Amyrlin Seat, much to the displeasure of Sephraem.

Category:Characters original to the video game
